security.contingency_selection: Up to 3 non-bridge line outages on each candidate's traced upstream pathway.

strategy_assumptions.hourly_profile: 27 deterministic synthetic operating scenarios (236,520 hours) bounded by the solved N-0 electrical ceiling.
strategy_assumptions.flexibility: Customer-side managed reduction follows the versioned activation policy.
strategy_assumptions.battery: State-of-charge, reserve, efficiency, power and energy are enforced; dispatch is representative planning, not real-time control.
strategy_assumptions.staging: Stages are representative; reinforcement scope and delivery dates are not modelled.

manifest.title: Synthetic Brandenburg operator-pilot replacement pack
manifest.geographic_scope: Fictional Brandenburg-like 110/20 kV network; not tied to a mapped substation
manifest.warning: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA. Not associated with an actual German substation, network operator, available capacity, connection offer, cost, or delivery date. Replace via operator_pilot_data_v1.
